candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child has cough or difficult breathing. There is no diarrhoea. There is no ear problem. There is no fever. I counted the breaths for one full minute before the bronchodilator, and the respiratory rate was 45. The child was calm during this assessment and there was no chest indrawing. Stridor was not present when the child was calm. I found wheezing. The child has not had recurrent wheeze. I completed a bronchodilator trial. After the bronchodilator, I counted the breaths for one full minute and the respiratory rate was 42. The child was calm and there was no chest indrawing after the bronchodilator. Pulse oximeter is not available. The cough has lasted for 3 days.
